What everyone needs to know aboutCh 4: Terrestrial and inland water systems
14 January 2011
WGII LAM1 Final Plenary

Novel features in relation to AR4
Core emphasis is on ecosystems rather than species
Dynamic view of ecosystems
Goal is to manage change, not prevent it
Emphasis on thresholds, limits, tipping points rather than equilibrium
Social-ecological systems view
People are part of ecosystems
Natural and transformed ecosystems are inextricably linked within living landscapes

Landuse/landcover change
Need for cross-chapter and cross-WG coordination to ensure that
Range of uncertainty in future LULC change is adequately specified
Suggest a fast-track synthesis and publishing exercise 
Selection of ‘reference scenarios’ of LULC change for comparative purposes
Suggest interaction with the RCP/SSP gang to specify this
